_comment: Pickle — Round 4 (M-26), compiler-ready merge gate. Accept in one word and drop into tests/math-baseline.json. Every pin below is produced by ONE stated extraction rule (see _extraction_rule) so it is reproducible byte-for-byte.

_extraction_rule.canonical: Project rule (DS funcdiff-full.js, agreed council tool): split the single inline <script> on '\n'; a function's body runs from its column-0 'function NAME(' line through the LAST line whose trim()==='}' before the NEXT column-0 'function' line; join with '\n' and hash WITHOUT a trailing newline.
_extraction_rule.why_stated: Two earlier pin sets existed and disagreed only because of unit ambiguity: (a) 'first ^} close' truncated multi-line bodies; (b) 'awk | shasum' added a trailing newline, moving every hash. A pin without its extraction rule is not a pin.
_extraction_rule.known_artefact: The canonical rule over-reads a function whose body is followed by a column-0 IIFE/glue statement (no column-0 'function' before the real next function). checkRewards is the one such case here — see _check_rewards_note. Exclude it from a differing-function tally, or scan with the first-'^}' close for that name only.
_extraction_rule.verification: Reproduced against DS's own tool: `node _agents/ds/tools/funcdiff-full.js <v20> <donor> --hashes` prints identical values (cpuPick 3dc9d12f500a / 94b878605b73).

_gate_semantics: exit 1 on any mismatch, naming the symbol. All 8 MATH functions + all 6 CONSTANTS are identical in both parents, so expect_from='identical' and the merged build must equal the single pinned hash. cpuPick is donor-only.
_supersedes: The older cpuPick pins a2b8190e98f8 / fa6d752969e4 were TRUNCATED-body pins (first-'^}' close) and are superseded by the full-body pins below. The older math/constant hashes from awk|shasum differed from these only by a trailing newline and are likewise superseded.

cpu_pick.note: DONOR is the keep target: curRound/topAvail/ovrFloor + first-sight posBest gate (rounds <=3) + floor-checked bounded miss (reach = 3 + min(9, ...)). v20's 3dc9d12f500a has no floors and an unbounded miss up to 92 deep. Full-body pins; the old a2b8190e98f8 / fa6d752969e4 were truncated-body pins and are void.

_constants_extraction: A constant's pin is the sha256 of its FIRST declaration line (`grep -m1 '^const NAME'`), trailing newline stripped, whitespace NOT normalised (byte-exact as written).
_also_protected_not_hashed_here: MC and PLAN_K are named as protected in AGENTS.md but are single-line consts inside the math region; the 8 functions above already depend on them, so a change to either would move matchupModel/simulateGame's hash. Add them as direct pins if the Architect wants: MC = {rb:0.0249,...} (v20:2046), PLAN_K = {kRun:1.4,...} (v20:2009).
_assertion_sketch: for each entry: extract the symbol's body by _extraction_rule, sha256 (no trailing newline), compare to pin; on mismatch print 'MATH GATE FAIL <name>: <got> != <pin>' and exit 1. cpuPick compares against the donor hash and additionally fails if it equals the v20 reject hash.
_check_rewards_note: checkRewards is NOT a real diff: its TRUE body (first-'^}' close) is identical in both parents — v20 6381-6408 = donor 6430-6457. CORRECTED 20 Oct (bulletin M-50 §5): the earlier pin value '0a000ce52783' is WITHDRAWN — it does not reproduce under any stated extraction rule. Under three stated rules the pair is IDENTICAL every time, so the FINDING is robust and only the old value was wrong: (A) `sed -n '6381,6408p' | tr -d '\n' | shasum -a 256` -> 25b49ab78262 both sides; (B) same with a trailing newline appended -> 9d929db5ad95 both sides; (C) plain `sed | shasum -a 256` (trailing newline kept) -> cd56a5bed115 both sides. Assertion of record: use (A) with its rule stated, or better, assert by `diff <(sed -n '6381,6408p' v20) <(sed -n '6430,6457p' donor)` being EMPTY — a claim proven by two independent rules is worth more than a pin nobody can re-derive. Under the canonical rule its span over-reads the adjacent column-0 `#glue` phone IIFE (v20 6409-6428 / donor 6458-6484, re-measured; previously mis-stated as 6409-6432 / 6458-6488), and THOSE glue blocks differ (v20 region sha256 8cfb2f6f6cfd / donor c0ae022f230e), which is why a canonical-rule scan lists checkRewards as 'differing'. It is excluded from the pin set and from the 17-count; the glue block is handled on the architecture surface, not here.
